x: Harry Shields, in finishing fifth in the scratch race, deserved some sort of reward for this, probably his best yet, and was placed second in the handicap, with Bill Mitchell, our second man to finish, third, with an allowance of 1 min. 45 sec.
Harry Shields was in the lead for some distance with Jack Flower a few yards behind; but from the Windmill home they strode in together with "Bill" Mitchell a few yards in the rear.
We decided to score 6 aside and managed to win fairly comfortably. "Bill" Mitchell, the individual winner, led practically from the start, and he seems to be getting back to his old form.

Championships in 1929, with myself 4th, Bill Mitchell 5th and we had our scoring 6 in the first 15 to finish. We thus took the team title from South London H. and actually won this championship 8 times out of 9 years and Arthur was our key man in most of these victories.

In 1929 Harry Hare, the first Belgrave President ever of the S.T.C.C.A., handed to his club mates the DEWAR Shield for winning the Championship (for the first time), and the six team winners medals to:- BILL MITCHELL (4), ARTHUR PENNY (7), ARTHUR ALLUM (12), BILL WEBB (16), PAUL KHLOPIN (23) and ALEC ROBERTSHAW (26).

ARTHUR ALLUM (4th), BILL RICE (13th), BILL MITCHELL (2nd), and ARTHUR PENNY (3rd) Winner of the event was none other than LES COHEN, then of Ashcombe A.C.; and our President of today, ALF HARLEY, was 97th.
